about: Ground truth for 'ELECTROSTATIC 1(1).pdf' (RCC Electrostatics-I module, 28 phone-photographed pages, 32,117,109 bytes, md5 311067df00768dfc054ca8cea04587f3), read page by page by eye. Layout facts only (no question text): section, printed number range per page column, question type, which questions have a printed figure. 'cols' lists [first,last] printed numbers in the left (L) and right (R) column; a question that continues into the next column is listed where it starts. The PDF itself is not in the repository.
notes: Exemplar Q4 starts at the bottom of page 25's left column and its options continue at the top of the right column.
Page 12 and page 24 photos include a strip of the NEXT page at the right edge (fragments of '21.', '22.', '23.' and '1.', '2.', '3.', '4.'). Those are not questions of the page.
Page 28 is photographed in landscape on a white background; the printed area is the middle ~55% of the image. It has no section banner (Exemplar continues).
AIIMS Q26-34 are Assertion-Reason items printed without options.
Handwritten ticks, circles and notes are present on many pages; they are not answers.
